$comment: HZ-383: the contract for a Task's Run plan block — the machine-readable part of the Run plan step's artifact, which HZ-378's Execute reads. Unlike the other *.schema.json files here it pairs with no data file in domain/: it is the contract for an agent's OUTPUT, emitted by the Run plan step and checked by domain/py/run_plan.py for the farm and read by domain/js/runPlan.js for the server's Approve the run card. Written in the same Draft-07 subset domain/validate.mjs honours. Rules the subset cannot express — every `env` value is a string naming a variable as `$NAME`, never a literal value — are asserted by the binding.
title: Horizon Task run plan

cwd.$comment: The working directory the commands run in, relative to the repository root. Never absolute, never `..` (asserted by the binding, HZ-415); Execute resolves it inside the repo's deploy-target checkout.

commands.$comment: ARRAY ORDER IS THE ORDER the commands run in.

env.$comment: Environment variables the commands need, each value a `$NAME` reference — never a literal (asserted by the binding).

runner.$comment: HZ-416: where Execute runs the commands. `container` is a throwaway rootless Podman container; `host` runs on the host exactly as before HZ-416. HZ-491: when absent, the server picks `container` only if the repo's deploy target pins a container image, else `host` (domain/js/runPlan.js effectiveRunner); the farm takes the server's value and applies no default.

reports.$comment: HZ-434: files the run writes as its own result, shown to Verify & report beside the log. A path is relative to `cwd` or absolute, never with a `..` part (asserted by both bindings). A command's `--report <path>` is found without this list. Execute reads a file only if its realpath is inside the resolved cwd or /tmp.

requires.$comment: HZ-502: every tool and file the commands need, checked on the runner before Impact review (farm/run_plan_requires.py). Each item has exactly one key. A `tool` name matches ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]*$ (so it never reads as an option). A `path` is relative to the checkout root, never absolute, never with a `..` part, and holds no control character. Asserted by both bindings.

proof.$comment: HZ-503: what proves each metric line, one entry per line, numbered as domain/py/fields.py criteria_lines() numbers the metric. Each entry names exactly one source: `command`, a 1-based index into `commands`, or `report`, `<path>#<field>` with both parts non-empty and the path listed in `reports`. Optional here, so a plan approved before HZ-503 still runs; farm/step_agent.py requires one entry per metric line when a Run plan reply is written. Exactly-one-source, the command range and the report rule are asserted by both bindings.
